# Muse Hub

> Independently developed for 15 independent Muse assistants, each with Main and three subchats; 75 skills, 25 workflows, 100 task starters, and 151 connectors.

## Start here
- [All downloads](https://atlas-origins.github.io/muse-ai-agent-presets/downloads.html)
- [Muse Hub](https://atlas-origins.github.io/muse-ai-agent-presets/)
- [Repository](https://github.com/atlas-origins/muse-ai-agent-presets)
- [Get started](https://github.com/atlas-origins/muse-ai-agent-presets/blob/main/docs/GETTING_STARTED.md)
